scope: Gate0 software and evidence-chain review of the synchronized S103 audit bundle; no model, data payload, outcome, score, or GPU execution

rules_applied: AI is limited to permitted mechanical implementation and review support
the user retains ownership of hypotheses, design, interpretation, conclusions, and novelty claims
all AI-produced code and claims require verification
no fabricated data or research misconduct
venue and institutional disclosure rules remain binding

findings.finding: The synchronized validator accepted an adapter review from any named or unnamed author as long as status and adapter SHA matched; it did not require a reviewer different from the protocol/adapter author or substantive findings and limitations.
findings.resolution: The local patch now requires a non-empty different reviewer identity, non-empty findings, and an explicit limitations list for both adapter and protocol reviews. The adapter author is declared and independently checked.

findings.finding: The review request invited approval of the pre-adapter v5 protocol SHA. Binding the adapter review later necessarily changes the canonical protocol SHA and makes that approval stale.
findings.resolution: A two-stage assembler and regression now enforce adapter review first, final protocol hash second, and different-author protocol review last.

findings.finding: The synchronized candidate validation receipt names v4 while current execution evidence names v5; a fresh validator receipt is required after review hardening and final evidence binding.
findings.resolution: Do not reuse the old receipt. Regenerate the candidate and validator receipt on the remote project after the hardened files are synchronized.

findings.finding: The dataset adapter source and source-evidence package are not present in the local synchronized audit bundle, and the SSH route is currently closed by the local network proxy before server authentication.
findings.resolution: A substantive adapter semantic review remains incomplete and must be performed by a genuinely different reviewer against the exact remote adapter SHA.

local_patch_state.reason: SSH connection closed by the managed network proxy at 198.18.0.19 before authentication
local_patch_state.next_safe_step: Reconnect, inspect the exact adapter/source evidence, transfer the hardened validator and assembler, run all server regressions, then obtain the two genuine reviews in order.

limitations: This is a same-agent self-audit and cannot satisfy either independent Gate0 decision.
No model forward or scoring is authorized.
